notes: Words you ask Crisp to put on screen are no longer run as commands. Asking it to "write mute it across the bottom" muted your audio instead of adding the caption; "overlay the text make it black and white" graded the clip; "type slow motion on it" halved the speed; "stick upscale it at the bottom" started a long render. Ten ways of asking for a caption were measured against four command-shaped phrases and half of them did the wrong thing — all of those now add the caption you asked for. Two phrasings that mention cropping still decline rather than captioning, and say so. Nothing got slower.
